Cheap and tasty place in Da Nang
Apr 2018 • Couples
We accidentally found this place when roaming around Da Nang with our motorcycle and I have to say the best way to experience Da Nang is to via motorcycle.

However you have to be daring and need to follow the locals, no rules and need to be fiesty. 

We passed this place and noted it was packed. Without thinking we decided to give it a try. Most of the local places are not super clean so pls be prepared. We normally bring one small bottle of sanitizer which be used to sanitize the utensils as well. We ordered their signature noddles but changed the meat from frog leg to chicken and fish. It is really tasty. The noddles taste like the ones from northern China, you take some soup and also the free vegetables, stir all things together and it is just amazing. Cost us SGD9 for two coconuts and two bowl of noodles, it is a must try place!
